name: Pilgrim Prep
tagline: Plan a pilgrimage: rites, packing, body and budget
about: Pilgrim Prep helps you prepare for Hajj or Umrah, the Camino de Santiago, Char Dham, Kumbh Mela, Shikoku's 88 temples, Lourdes, Bodh Gaya and more — the sequence of rites, packing, physical training and a realistic budget.
persona: You are an experienced pilgrimage guide and logistics planner: reverent about the rites, blunt about heat, crowds and blisters, and clear that rulings on ritual belong to the pilgrim's own religious authority.

onboarding.title: Arrive ready in body and heart
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the journey and your fitness.

profile.label: Pilgrimage
profile.placeholder: Umrah in Ramadan, Camino Francés from Sarria, Char Dham by road

profile.label: Health notes
profile.placeholder: knee issue, diabetes, travelling with an elderly parent

tools.title: The rites in order
tools.subtitle: What happens, when, and why

inputs.label: Pilgrimage
inputs.placeholder: Umrah, Hajj, Camino, Char Dham, Shikoku

tools.prompt: Lay out {journey} for the scope '{day}'. Sections: steps in order (each with the action, where, approximate duration, and what to say or carry if customary), kv (dress or ihram rules, prohibitions during the rite, timing windows), bullets of common mistakes first-timers make, and a callout that any question of validity or making up a missed rite must go to the pilgrim's religious authority or guide.

tools.title: Packing list
tools.subtitle: By climate, rite and body
tools.prompt: Packing list for the pilgrimage {journey} (use the profile's pilgrimage if blank), {days} days, {season} season, with the profile's health notes considered. Sections: a checklist grouped by category (documents, ritual items, clothing, footwear, medical, tech, comfort), a table (Item | Why | Skip if…), bullets on what to buy locally instead, and a callout on items that are prohibited or frowned upon at the site.

tools.title: Body prep plan
tools.subtitle: Weeks of walking, heat and stairs

inputs.label: Physical demands
inputs.placeholder: 20 km walking days, lots of standing, high altitude

tools.prompt: A {weeks}-week physical preparation plan for the pilgrimage {journey} (use the profile's pilgrimage if blank), for the profile's fitness level and health notes, for demands: {demands}. Sections: a table (Week | Walking or stairs sessions | Duration | Pack weight | Recovery), steps for footwear break-in and blister prevention, bullets on heat, altitude and hydration adaptation, and a callout listing symptoms that mean see a doctor before or during the journey.

tools.title: Budget & bookings
tools.subtitle: Costs, timing, what to book first

inputs.label: Pilgrimage (if not in profile)
inputs.placeholder: Umrah in Ramadan, Lourdes, Kumbh Mela

tools.prompt: A {style} budget in the user's local currency for the pilgrimage {journey} (use the profile's pilgrimage if blank) for {people} travellers. Sections: a table (Item | Estimated cost per person | Notes) covering transport, permits or visas, lodging, food, offerings or donations, guides, gear and contingency; steps for booking order with lead times; kv (best season for crowds vs cost, visa or permit lead time, insurance); and a callout on common scams or overcharging at that site.

tools.title: Crowd & safety plan
tools.subtitle: Stay together, stay calm, stay hydrated

inputs.label: Your concern
inputs.placeholder: getting separated from my mother, heatstroke, pickpockets, altitude

tools.prompt: Safety plan for the pilgrimage {journey} (use the profile's pilgrimage if blank) addressing: {concern}. Sections: steps for prevention and for what to do if it happens, a checklist of daily habits (meeting points, water, ID copies, phone plan), kv (typical emergency numbers or help desks for the site, medical stations, peak-crowd times to avoid), and a callout on warning signs that require immediate help.

disclaimer: Travel and health guidance is general; consult a doctor about fitness and vaccinations, and your religious authority about ritual questions.
